claim_boundary: The execution centrepiece is an offline diagnostic. It is not PnL, not live-trading evidence and not a production execution simulator.

claims.safe_rewording: The centrepiece shows a forecasting-versus-signal-quality gap using retained offline diagnostic tables.
claims.scope: retained predictive/calibration summaries joined to proxy diagnostics

claims.safe_rewording: Report confidence filtering as an offline signal-quality proxy diagnostic.
claims.scope: confidence filtering, retained fraction and active fraction by threshold

claims.safe_rewording: Report active fraction shrinkage under confidence filtering.
claims.scope: active fraction by objective, horizon and confidence threshold

claims.safe_rewording: Report turnover proxy as signal churn, not real order turnover.
claims.scope: turnover proxy by objective, horizon and confidence threshold

claims.safe_rewording: Report cost-adjusted proxy and latency sensitivity as offline diagnostics.
claims.scope: cost sensitivity and row-step latency sensitivity retained tables

claims.safe_rewording: Report adverse-selection proxy by confidence bucket; it is a proxy, not measured adverse selection.
claims.scope: adverse-selection proxy by confidence bucket and fill assumption

claims.safe_rewording: State that the centrepiece does not establish profitability or tradability.
Use cost-adjusted proxy wording, not PnL wording.
Describe the output as an offline diagnostic only.
